FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Habitat sorting with a giggle built in — a camel in the coral! Ask what each wrong animal needs instead: sand, grass, sunshine.

Prefer paper? The Dolphin’s Ocean Discovery worksheet prints the same experiment with room to think and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
